metadata.description: The product judgment Ravi Teja Palanki uses to ship AI, written down and version controlled. 91 skills (an always-on orchestrator and 90 specialist skills across AI PM, research, writing, and design) and 11 slash commands. AI product management is where the depth sits; the same discipline works on any question. Check the evidence first, say so when the direction is wrong, and end with the action rather than the summary.
